fields.label: Section
fields.description: The name used in the options. Empty: the options without a section (Ingredients).

fields.label: Option List
fields.description: Shared options (Sauces, Cooking point…): offered in this section with the item's own

fields.label: Minimum choices
fields.description: 0 = optional. 1 or more = the waiter must choose before adding the item

fields.label: Free choices
fields.description: The first N extras chosen don't add to the price (the cheapest ones), e.g. 2 free sauces

fields.label: Ingredient modes
fields.description: Each chosen option offers the restaurant's modes (Light, Extra, On the side…)

fields.label: Price by size
fields.description: The prices of this section grow with the item's size: each size (variant) sets its Option price factor in its Restaurant tab (Large = 1.5).
